text: When Reset Folder Order reaches a folder with NO_SORT_VALUE, descendants can still have custom order. clearUserSortOrder recurses before the guard, clears changed folder values, and refreshes their rows. Its local recursive helper leaves the completion event to the outer call, after subtree work. The accepted source retains this ordering. It does not precollect all folders before mutation. No live reset or event-count test was run.
title: Folder-order reset traverses descendants before skipping an unchanged parent
